description: SvDockManager pop-out to a native window in Svelte 5. allowPopout, off by default, adds a pop-out button to each tab that opens the panel in a separate browser window for a second monitor: a monitoring console keeps its Live log and Metrics panels streaming in the popped-out window while the main console stays in place, styles and theme carry across, closing the window docks the panel back, and a blocked pop-up falls back to an in-app floating window.
keywords: svelte open panel in browser window

faq.question: How does the panel render in another window?
faq.answer: The manager opens a window, copies the stylesheets and theme attributes into it and mounts the panel's content there; Svelte state stays in the main page, so live data keeps flowing.

faq.question: What if pop-ups are blocked?
faq.answer: The manager detects the blocked window and floats the panel inside the app instead, so the action never fails silently.

faq.question: How does the panel come back?
faq.answer: Closing the popped-out window docks the panel to its previous position, and the dock API's popout call can reverse it from code.
